verdict: Not production-ready as-is. One confirmed P0 ships an unauthenticated SSRF to cloud metadata (IAM credential theft) on a public endpoint, and one confirmed P1 IDOR leaks/writes cross-tenant data on an internal multi-tenant app. The build is clean (type-check, lint, 3672 tests green) and architecture/auth discipline is broadly sound, but the test suite is theatre on the surfaces that matter most: 82 API test files mock Prisma so no test proves org-scoped queries actually filter, integration/RLS tests are env-gated and skipped in every normal run, and OAuth callback, GSC, admin, and auto-publish paths have zero behavioral coverage. The database migration system is also non-functional as a deploy/DR mechanism — migrations reconstruct ~58 of 214 models and production has zero migration-ledger rows — but this blocks no live deploy/build/runtime path (Vercel runs prisma generate + next build, not migrate deploy) so it is debt, not a gate. Fix the two security defects, add the cross-tenant regression test that proves the IDOR fix holds, ship; everything else is fast-follow.

scorecard.oneLine: type-check exit 0, lint clean at --max-warnings 0, 3672 passed / 0 failed in 18s. Production build not independently run (Vercel green) and coverage thresholds not enforced — minor gaps, not blockers.

Confirmed P0: validateExternalUrl bypassed by IPv4-mapped IPv6 ([::ffff:169.254.169.254]) on the public demo endpoint, reaching cloud metadata; guard also does no DNS resolution. JWT-tier, CORS, OAuth returnTo, org-scope in ask-synthex all correctly mitigated; no committed secrets.

Auth centralisation strong across 664 routes, but GET /api/comments authenticates without authorizing — confirmed cross-tenant IDOR (read+write). In-memory rate limiter is ineffective on serverless (P2); error-swallow and auth-fragmentation are hygiene.

GA4 token read bypasses self-heal and dies hourly until manual reconnect (P1, real user impact, scoped to one endpoint). LinkedIn stores no refresh_token (P2, pre-existing). Lead-3 cron 500s unverifiable from source — needs Vercel logs.

Suite is green but provides false confidence: 82 files mock Prisma (no real org-scope verification), integration/RLS tests skipped by env gate, OAuth-callback/GSC/admin routes have zero behavioral coverage, auto-publish failure modes are 27 it.todo() stubs.

Schema valid (214 models) but migrations reconstruct only ~58 and prod has zero ledger rows — DR/bootstrap is broken. Blocks no live deploy path (Vercel does not run migrate deploy) and the dangerous command is already gated, so it is high-priority debt, not a release gate.

blockers.title: P0 SSRF: validateExternalUrl bypassed by IPv4-mapped IPv6 — cloud metadata reachable from public /api/demo/analyze
blockers.fix: In lib/security/validate-url.ts add BLOCKED_PATTERNS entries /^\[::ffff:/i and /^::ffff:/i (and /^\[::ffff:0:/i). Then close the structural hole the same way: resolve the hostname with dns.lookup / net.isIP and re-check the resolved IP against the private/metadata ranges before any fetch, so a DNS-rebinding domain pointing at 169.254.169.254 is also blocked. Apply nothing else to call sites — they already call validateExternalUrl.
blockers.verification: node -e "new URL(...)" check from the finding returns BLOCKED; then live: POST https://synthex.social/api/demo/analyze -d '{"url":"http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]/latest/meta-data"}' must return HTTP 400 with an error field, not a fetched body. Add a unit test in tests/security covering bracketed + bare mapped forms.

blockers.title: P1 IDOR: GET/POST /api/comments authenticate but do not authorize — cross-tenant comment read and write
blockers.fix: In app/api/comments/route.ts, before the findMany (line 152) and inside POST, load the parent content by contentType+contentId and verify the caller owns it or shares its organizationId (e.g. contentType==='campaign' -> prisma.campaign.findFirst({where:{id:contentId,userId}})), returning 404 if null. Mirror the documented content-library pattern. Add the ownership gate to all four contentType branches.
blockers.verification: As user A create content X + comment; as user B (different org) GET /api/comments?contentType=campaign&contentId=X must return 404/403, not the list; POST as B must also be rejected. Paste both curl responses.

blockers.title: Cross-tenant (403/404) regression test for comments — prove the IDOR fix holds and is not Prisma-mocked
blockers.fix: Add tests/unit/api/comments-authz.test.ts that invokes the real GET/POST handlers and asserts a different-org/different-user caller gets 404/403 for both read and reply. Do NOT mock away the ownership check. This converts the IDOR fix from 'asserted' to 'proven' and seeds the missing cross-org coverage pattern.
blockers.verification: npx jest --testPathPattern='comments-authz' shows passing 401, 403/404, and 200-owner cases; the ownership query is exercised, not mocked.

blockers.title: P1: GA4 OAuth tokens expire hourly and never refresh — /api/integrations/ga4/properties 401s/502s after ~1h
blockers.fix: In app/api/integrations/ga4/properties/route.ts select the connection id and retrieve the token via lib/google/google-auth.ts getOAuthAccessToken(connection.id) instead of decryptField(connection.accessToken), reusing the existing lazy-refresh+persist path exactly as search-console-oauth.ts and business-profile.ts do.
blockers.verification: Set a googleanalytics platform_connections.expiresAt to the past, GET /api/integrations/ga4/properties -> expect HTTP 200 with properties and the row's accessToken/expiresAt updated. Audit for any other googleanalytics/googledrive reader using decryptField directly.

blockers.fix: Pull last-7-day Vercel cron invocation logs + env audit for app/api/cron/dr-gbp-oauth-refresh (500-by-design on missing DR_GBP_OAUTH_*/VERCEL_* env), app/api/cron/seo-audits (reported require()-of-ESM, no static culprit found — likely transitive dep), and app/api/cron/autopilot. blockers.title: Close behavioral coverage on the unprotected-by-tests critical paths (OAuth callback, admin, auto-publish State-1/State-6)
blockers.fix: Add behavioral tests that invoke real handlers: (a) auth-callback-platform — state-missing/mismatch redirect behavior, upsert (not duplicate) of PlatformConnection with correct userId+organizationId; (b) admin-routes — 401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 200 admin for users/audit-log/vault/upgrade-subscription using the existing approvals-roles.contract pattern; (c) implement auto-publish State-1 (401 -> hold, no retry) and State-6 (idempotency) from the it.todo() spec. Use the contract-test (real handler, mocked prisma) pattern, not string-scan ratchets.
blockers.verification: npx jest for each new suite shows passing 401/403/200 (admin) and state-validation (callback) cases; auto-publish suite shows 0 todo for State-1 and State-6.

blockers.title: P2 SSRF hardening: gate website-analyzer Firecrawl path and YouTube thumbnailUrl fetch
blockers.fix: Add validateExternalUrl(url) at the top of analyzeWebsite() in lib/ai/website-analyzer.ts (before the scrapeWithFirecrawl call) so both scrape tiers are guarded; add validateExternalUrl(videoData.thumbnailUrl) before the fetch at app/api/social/youtube/post/route.ts:286 with try/catch -> 400. Both depend on SEC-SSRF-IPV6 for full coverage of the mapped-IPv6 form.
blockers.verification: POST /api/brand-dna/extract {url:'http://169.254.169.254/'} -> 400; POST /api/social/youtube/post with thumbnailUrl:'http://169.254.169.254/' -> 400 (auth cookie required).

blockers.title: P2: Execute and verify production migration baseline — migrations reconstruct ~58 of 214 models, prod ledger empty
blockers.fix: Run the already-drafted database/remediation/synthex-baseline-20260527 sequence (preflight, apply 26 missing tables, stamp _prisma_migrations baseline, verify), then squash a from-empty baseline migration via prisma migrate diff. CEO sign-off required (DB migration). Also document the prisma-owns-DDL / supabase-owns-RLS boundary in CLAUDE.md.
blockers.verification: SELECT count(*) FROM _prisma_migrations on prod returns the baselined rows; remediation verify script reports zero missing tables; against a shadow DB, prisma migrate diff --from-migrations --to-schema-datamodel --exit-code returns 0.

blockers.title: P2: LinkedIn stores no refresh_token — silent reconnect every ~60 days, no proactive warning
blockers.fix: Confirm LinkedIn app enrollment in LinkedIn's refresh-token program (NOT an offline_access scope string — that does nothing). If enrolled, request the refresh grant; until then surface a proactive 'reconnect required' notification before the ~60-day token expiry and do not claim auto-refresh works for LinkedIn.
blockers.verification: After corrected re-auth, a LinkedIn platform_connections row has refreshToken NOT NULL and linkedin-service.refreshToken() returns new creds without throwing; otherwise a pre-expiry notification fires.

blockers.title: P2: Back AI-route rate limiting with Upstash + stop dashboard GETs masking outages as 200
blockers.fix: Wrap the expensive AI routes (video/generate, content/industry, google-business auto-reply) with the existing lib/rate-limit Upstash-backed limiter instead of APISecurityChecker's in-memory Map. Separately, in the ~5 dashboard GET error-swallow routes either return 500 or add degraded:true and ensure logger.error feeds Sentry so outages are alertable.
blockers.verification: Hammer POST /api/video/generate beyond policy limit across cold starts -> consistent 429s; force a Prisma error on /api/dashboard/content-intelligence -> error reaches Sentry rather than a clean 200.

risksIfShippedNow: Unauthenticated attacker steals cloud IAM credentials via the public demo endpoint by fetching instance metadata through the mapped-IPv6 SSRF bypass — full account/infra compromise, the single most severe finding

Any authenticated tenant reads and writes comments on other tenants' campaigns/posts/projects by enumerating contentId (IDOR) — cross-tenant data leak and tampering on an internal multi-tenant app, with no test that would catch it because 82 API test files mock Prisma
GA4 integration appears connected then silently breaks ~1 hour after every connect, returning 401/502 forever until manual reconnect — recurring, user-visible reliability failure

Unknown production cron health: reported 500s on dr-gbp-oauth-refresh / seo-audits / autopilot are unverified from source, so scheduled GBP/SEO/autopilot jobs may be silently failing in prod right now
Green CI is misleading: integration and RLS-adversarial tests are env-gated and skipped, so a regression in org-scoped DB filtering or RLS would pass CI undetected
Dashboard outages are invisible to status-code monitoring — ~5 GET routes return 200 with empty payloads on DB failure, so a real backend fault shows users 'nothing connected' instead of alerting ops

No working disaster recovery: production cannot be reconstructed from migrations (only ~58 of 214 models) and the ledger is empty — a clean-environment rebuild or restore would not reproduce the live schema
LinkedIn connections die ~every 60 days with no proactive warning, requiring manual reconnect — degraded but non-catastrophic
